translations.en:
At first glance it is
merely a dead tree, but it
is actually a tree monster
animated by sorcery. It
attacks people and decorates
itself with their bones as
though they were medals.
Perhaps because it was once
a tree, it moves sluggishly,
so you should have no trouble
defeating it. Anyone who
loses will simply become
its newest accessory.

translations.en:
"All I could feel was
despair." Every adventurer
who has encountered one
says the same thing.

If you meet one in a
labyrinth, its menace
will leave you trembling.
If escape is possible,
we recommend fleeing
before it kills you
or turns you to stone.

translations.en:
Many adventurers approach
it thinking it is merely a
stuffed toy, but it seems
to be a variant of the
Vorpal Bunny. Its appearance
makes it all too easy to
lower your guard, even
in battle. Those who do
will fall victim to its
characteristic decapitating
attack. Perhaps this is a good
example of how exceptional
cuteness can sometimes
be a formidable weapon.

translations.en:
This dragon is
recognized as a variant
wreathed in flames.

Said to have lived amid
fire since birth, it has
extremely hard scales that
make dull weapons a hopeless
proposition. Even spell
attacks from a distance are
met with its powerful breath.

Learn where these dragons
live and take every precaution
to avoid encountering them.

translations.en:
A variant of scorpion
with a shell as
hard as steel.

An irritant thought to
be venom drips from its
gleaming golden tail. Its
foul stench is enough to
make you turn away. It is
still only a bug, however,
and should be no match
for a seasoned adventurer.

translations.en:
Its body evolved to survive
in lands of extreme cold,
making it more dangerous
to adventurers than
an ordinary werewolf.

It does more than simply
attack. Reports describe a
cruel habit of paralyzing
its victims and tormenting
them once they cannot move.

If you face one, end
the fight before it
starts enjoying itself.
After all, you are not
playing a game with it.

translations.en:
Like other wererats, it
is frail but extremely
nimble. True to its
name, a pack attack
could leave everything
as devastated as the
aftermath of a cyclone.

Take particular care against
its swift movements. Its
sharp teeth and claws
also harbor many germs and
pathogens. As with any wererat,
wounds it inflicts must
be thoroughly disinfected.

translations.en:
It is beautiful enough
to be mistaken for a
statue, but that lovely
appearance is merely
a deception. Reports
frequently describe it
posing as a statue to
ambush passing adventurers.

Many adventurers have suffered
grievous injuries from a breath attack
launched in just such an ambush.

translations.en:
It has a jet-black body, gleaming golden
eyes, sharp red claws and a tail stinger that
look as though they were stained with blood.

This is a monster that warrants
a higher level of caution
during your adventures.

Perhaps its name comes from
the many parties it has
wiped out, bursting from the
darkness before they could
even make out its shape.

translations.en:
An ogre variant whose skin
is said to have turned
bright red from anger. Like
an ordinary ogre, it has
no intelligence and attacks
indiscriminately. The force
of its charge is astonishing.

However, an adventurer of
average ability need not fear
it, provided they remain calm in
the face of its reckless rush.

translations.en:
It appears to be a relative
of the djinn, and seems
to attack humans for sheer
enjoyment. It is also
frequently seen draining energy.

Reports describe it tormenting
adventurers and then abandoning
them. This is only speculation,
but perhaps it is merely
"playing" with adventurers
rather than fighting them.

translations.en:
It is said to be the wretched
remains of a soul that
wandered into the labyrinth.

It seems to strengthen
itself by absorbing
other souls. Presumably,
it attacks adventurers
in search of more.

Perhaps drawing on the souls it
has absorbed, it is a formidable
enemy that employs magic and a
wide range of special attacks.

translations.en:
A magical creature a mage fashioned
from the mist surrounding the
city. It looks so fragile that
a wave of air might disperse
it, yet it attacks by releasing
various kinds of smoke. Its
appearance often causes people
to underestimate it. Let
your guard down, however, and
you will never return alive,
instead joining those who
wander the labyrinth forever.

A magical creature a mage
created by further strengthening
Living Armor to serve as a
bodyguard. Its master's orders
are absolute. Even now, with
its master gone, it attacks
adventurers in an effort to
carry out those commands.
One wishes its creator had
at least included a condition
under which it should retreat.

translations.en:
A golem said to have
been made during the age
when the Dragoons ruled.

Its material remains unidentified.
Its body is so sturdy that anyone
trying to collect a sample will
find dull weapons and spells
wholly inadequate to defeat it.

Its blows are powerful
enough to crush a
human head with ease.

translations.en:
A demon whose name means
"one who blocks the way."
It is said to have been
a knight consumed by a
demon. Another theory
holds that it made a pact
with a demon to gain
greater power for its
lord. Either way, it is
the ruin of a human who
sought power. Beware of
focusing all your attention
on defeating the mounted
knight: its horse can also
attack with its breath.

translations.en:
It is said that once
you hear its mocking
laughter, even your soul
will be tortured and
sucked away. Like other
demons, it delights only
in tormenting humans,
unleashing different attacks
to enjoy their reactions.

Although its original power
is sealed, there can be little
doubt that it remains a greater
threat than other demons.

translations.en:
As its name suggests, many
of its attacks seal spells,
making it an especially bad
opponent for spellcasters.

It likes to toy with its
prey after sealing their
magic, almost as if it
feeds on their fear. Even
if you win, escaping the
labyrinth will be hopeless
unless you can restore
your sealed spells.

translations.en:
A monster that seems clad in
armor made of precious metal.
It cannot resist shiny objects,
and has reportedly attacked
adventurers to steal even
the things they are wearing.

Although it mainly crawls
along the ground, it moves
quickly. It also attacks
with the precious objects
it has collected. The
power within those objects
appears to increase the
force of its attacks.

translations.en:
Tradition claims this
slime is mutated lava.
Whether that is true is
uncertain, but it is
always wrapped in searing
flames and certainly
resembles moving lava.
Bubbles also rise from
its body, supposedly
releasing a foul smell
when they burst. It is
not particularly strong,
being only a slime
variant, but the gas it
releases calls for caution.
